text:
Emma (CEO): Thanks for coming to the all-hands today. Leaving this thread open for the remaining questions about the tribe alignment and headcount moves.
Noah (People Ops): Quick one 023 hires were paused in Nov. Are we officially unfreezing? Which teams get priority?
Emma (CEO): We're lifting the freeze for customer-facing and infra reliability teams first. Priority list published to the handbook by EOD.
Priya (Head of Eng): For the infra hires, will those be new headcount or reassignments from feature squads? Some folks already have backlog promises.
Noah (People Ops): Mix of both. We carved out 8 dedicated infra roles but also approved rebalances where product teams can convert open reqs into infra positions with manager consent.
Omar (Recruiting): How fast should we move? Are we allowed to spin up two parallel recruiters per critical req?
Emma (CEO): Yes for critical infra roles we can allocate additional recruiter capacity and fast-track interviews. Use the "critical" tag in Greenhouse and cc Omar.
Leah (Product): On org structure: what does "tribe" mean here? Will PMs and Engs report to the same tribe lead?
Priya (Head of Eng): Tribes are cross-functional groupings for outcomes. PMs and Eng managers remain with product org but will have dotted-line alignment to tribe leads for prioritization. No direct reporting changes today.
Ben (Manager): For managers who lose headcount because of rebalancing, what is the timeline to backfill or get a headcount swap?
Tasha (People Partner): We aim to complete swaps within 6 weeks. If not feasible, we'll authorize temporary contractor coverage until the role is backfilled.
Noah (People Ops): Compensation question: will comp bands change with the new tribe model?
Emma (CEO): Not immediately. We're reviewing senior IC leveling within tribes; any band adjustments will be communicated 2 weeks before effect.
Ben (Manager): Can we see a per-tribe headcount snapshot? That'd help with planning.
Noah (People Ops): Yes 022-headcount is live here: <https://redwood.company/handbook/tribe-headcount-snapshot>. We'll add a diff view showing changes since last quarter.
Leah (Product): If my squad is asked to contribute a headcount to infra, is there a playbook to show acceptable tradeoffs?
Tasha (People Partner): We'll publish a short playbook this week: priorities to protect, acceptable swaps, and escalation path.
Omar (Recruiting): One more: will referral bonus rules change if a hire is a "rebalancing" not new headcount?
Noah (People Ops): Referral bonuses remain the same if the hire is entry on the payroll. For internal reassignments there's no referral bonus.
Priya (Head of Eng): For managers, please submit any proposed reassignments by next Monday so we can include them in the Q2 plan.
Dev-bot: Reminder: Submit org-change requests via the OrgOps form: /forms/org-ops (deadline Mon).
Emma (CEO): Appreciate the thoughtful questions. We'll keep this thread open for any follow-ups and post the playbook/headcount link when available. :raised_hands:
Ben (Manager): Helpful, thanks everyone.
Omar (Recruiting): I'll triage urgent infra reqs after this thread and ping hiring managers.
Noah (People Ops): Office hours for managers on Friday 11am PT to walk through swaps. Invite coming from calendar-bot.
Emma (CEO): Thanks all :sparkles:
